crossRefs.note: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.
He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.
Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
Folly is bound up in the heart of a child: the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.
Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.
For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of…
All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of…
The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.
A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
His father had not displeased him at any time in saying, “Why have you done so?” and he was also a very handsome man…

translations.web: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.
translations.bsb: A rod of correction imparts wisdom, but a child left to himself disgraces his mother.
translations.kjv: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
translations.asv: The rod and reproof give wisdom; But a child left to himself causeth shame to his mother.
